task: On https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger, what does the Conservation section say about the estimated wild tiger population? Quote the sentence and give the URL.

outcome.answer:
The Conservation section of the Tiger article has no prose sentence that gives an estimated wild tiger population. It gives the estimate in a table headed "Global wild tiger population", which lists country estimates for 2022 and a total:

- India: 3,167–3,682
- Russia: 573–600
- Indonesia: 393
- Nepal: 316–355
- Thailand: 148–189
- Malaysia: <150
- Bhutan: 131
- Bangladesh: 118–122
- China: >60
- Myanmar: 28
- **Total: 5,638–5,899**

I read the section text for sentences about the estimate and found none. The nearest prose is about protection laws and national action plans, such as: "Internationally, the tiger is protected under CITES Appendix I, banning trade of live tigers and their body parts."

URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger (section "Conservation", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger#Conservation)
